editorial_change.description: Editorial or typographical clarification with zero semantic impact on normative criteria.

control_definition_clarification.description: Refinement or clarification of a control evaluation condition without changing its scope.

control_addition_or_removal.description: Addition or deletion of any atomic control breaks the 65-control invariant and mandates a new CQS version.

weight_reallocation.description: Modification of nominal weights at control, subcriterion, or domain level mandates a new CQS version.

normative_threshold_change.description: Altering PASS/FAIL thresholds (e.g. changing LCP from 2.5s to 2.0s) mandates a new CQS version.
